runbooks.title: Sign-in fails on desirableproperties.org
steps: Confirm user is on https://desirableproperties.org (not www or :3005).
Ask for browser and whether popups are blocked.
If Web3Auth whitelist error, note domain must be desirableproperties.org apex.
Escalate to human if sign-in works on Gov Hub but not DP site.

runbooks.title: Canopi / Go Meta on book viewer
steps: Confirm chapter URL on book.desirableproperties.org or desirableproperties.org/viewer.
Request full-window screenshot including browser address bar.
Check whether Go Meta tab appears; note Canopi embed id if missing.
Escalate if embed returns 404 from api.canopi.live.

runbooks.title: Workgroup join or Gov Hub link
steps: Point user to workgroups page for canonical DP slugs.
If SSL/network error on Gov Hub, explain home router/DNS blocking is common.
Do not change Gov Hub membership via support – direct to workgroup coordinator.

runbooks.title: DP draft content clarification
steps: Ask for DP number and suggested revision text.
Direct substantive edits to Gov Hub workgroup discussion or patches.
Support can clarify process, not approve canonical text alone.

escalationRules.when: category content_clarification with DP patch text
